final: WITH per_actor AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_actor), shares AS (SELECT p.actor_id, p.cnt, p.cnt * 1.0 / t.total_cnt AS share FROM per_actor p JOIN total t ON t.total_cnt IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares) SELECT s.actor_id, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS diff FROM shares s JOIN avg_share a ON a.avg_s IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
